policy_floor: Software title normalisation layer routed row, clause 1 (lock first, sentinel in the same transaction)
trigger: upsert_product or upsert_alias commits while a normalisation pass that selected the row earlier then stamps the current pack_version over a later sentinel
classification_rationale: the header and the routed row bind every registry writer; the two existing writers were single statements with no lock and no sentinel, and the tests presented the unlocked sequence as the contract
summary: Both writers run in one transaction: SET LOCAL statement/lock timeouts, the blocking advisory lock on the pass's key, a pre-image read, the upsert, then the sentinel. Fixed in 9d587d35a, 7c0c63b39, a207b6f7b.

trigger: a writer queues behind a pass that holds the lock for more than 10 s
classification_rationale: the pool sets lock_timeout = 10 s on every connection and Postgres applies it to advisory-lock waits, so the claimed 90 s wait was 10 s
summary: take_normalization_lock also sets lock_timeout; a failure was already fail-soft (nothing written, no invalidation lost). a207b6f7b.

trigger: a caller refreshing an alias or a product each evaluator cycle
classification_rationale: marking every row stale on a no-op write re-queues the whole permanent dimension each cycle
summary: Each writer reads the current row under the lock and marks nothing when the write changes no resolution. 7c0c63b39.

trigger: an enrolled agent whose id is software_normalization sends repeated full inventory reports
classification_rationale: advisory-lock keys are one cluster-wide space; the bare agent-id key equals the normaliser's fixed string
summary: The replace lock key is 'software_inventory_store:' || agent_id, with a test; the vuln store's comment and adversarial test no longer model the bare key. 67813f366, 7c0c63b39.

trigger: a tick of up to 100 passes each starting a fresh 60 s budget
classification_rationale: no overall bound on a tick
summary: run_tick takes one tick_budget (60 s); a later pass starts only while kMinLaterPassBudget (5 s) remains; a stop on the budget reports capped. 67813f366, 7c0c63b39.

trigger: a title whose name, publisher and ecosystem exceed 2,400 bytes
classification_rationale: the title is dropped from title_triples with no trace
summary: The catalogue refresh counts them in the same snapshot and writes one warning; the manual says so. 67813f366, b62cad50b.

trigger: a future curation route lands many aliases in one session
classification_rationale: a new or re-pointed alias marks every settled row stale (the alias key cannot be reproduced in SQL); under-marking would violate clause 1
summary: Contracted over-marking, safe direction, no production caller. Note for the curation-route PR: batch the sentinel when writing aliases in bulk.
